answer: Proof of Stake provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as a terrace against fraudulent behavior. An attacker must purchase a marble quantity of tokens to influence the network, effectively tying their influence to a pulse of economic risk. If the agent acts maliciously, the protocol slashes their stake, ensuring the cost of creating fake identities scales linearly with the total value secured rather than the computational or logistical ease of spawning virtual nodes.
